name: shader-grain-gradient-ultraviolet
title: Shader Grain Gradient Ultraviolet
description: Electric magenta and blue blob morphing on ultraviolet black. A WebGL shader backdrop; the ultraviolet preset of shader-grain-gradient.
useWhen: A loud, electric hero for a bold launch or a music-style edit.
Foreground is light text or a bright product shot that needs a dark field around it.
You want a finished Grain Gradient look without tuning the palette and parameters yourself.
avoidWhen: The video must use your brand colors: start from `shader-grain-gradient` and set `colors`.
You want a lighter, contrasting mood from the same shader: use `shader-grain-gradient-blush`.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Colors
variables.description: Up to 7 colors, comma separated, from the edge of the shape to its core.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast the shape drifts. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Softness
variables.description: How softly the colors blend. 0 gives hard bands.

variables.label: Intensity
variables.description: How strongly the grain distorts the shape.

variables.label: Noise
variables.description: Amount of grain speckle over the colors.

variables.label: Scale
variables.description: Zooms the gradient in or out.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster but coarsens the grain.
